utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Uli. I’m still looking for a couple more helpers for Saturday at the front porch if you know anyone who can lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help at the front porch on Saturday. I don’t know anyone else to bring along, but I’ll be there.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, 10 a.m. at the front porch on Saturday works for me. I’ll be there to help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great, Oren — thanks for helping. See you at the front porch Saturday at 10 a.m.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Pia — I’ll keep it simple and reach out to a couple of neighbors who can help on Saturday. Let me know what time you want them at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Rosa. Let’s have them there at 10 a.m. on the front porch so everything stays simple.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yes, I’ll be at the front porch Saturday to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thank you, Vik — that’s a huge help! I’ll make sure everything’s ready at the front porch Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, I’ll keep it simple and see if I can point a couple of helpers your way for Saturday on the porch.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Rosa — that’d be a big help. I’m planning to be there at 10 a.m. Saturday at the front porch.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Yes, I can help at the front porch on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Uli. Can you come a little early to help set up?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Great, Sam — thank you. Let’s keep it simple and meet at the front porch on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sounds good, Pia. I’ll be there Saturday at the front porch and ready to help.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
